partners.mechanism_chain: ABCC6 (HGNC:21765) —DISRUPTS→ elastin metabolism and extracellular matrix organization (GO:0005576); elastin metabolism and extracellular matrix organization (GO:0005576) —LEADS_TO→ abnormal elastic fibers (HP:0001073); PSMC3 (HGNC:9752) —DISRUPTS→ elastin metabolism and extracellular matrix organization (GO:0005576); PSMC3 (HGNC:9752) —LEADS_TO→ cataract (HP:0000518); PSMC3 (HGNC:9752) —LEADS_TO→ hearing impairment (HP:0000365); PSMC3 (HGNC:9752) —LEADS_TO→ intellectual disability (HP:0001249); PSMC3 (HGNC:9752) —LEADS_TO→ polyneuropathy (HP:0004889). partners.mechanism_chain: ABCC6 (HGNC:20084) —DISRUPTS→ ATP-binding cassette transporter activity (GO:0005524); ATP-binding cassette transporter activity (GO:0005524) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal elastic tissue mineralization (HP:0001057); VCP (HGNC:12457) —DISRUPTS→ proteasomal degradation (GO:0006508); proteasomal degradation (GO:0006508) —LEADS_TO→ Axonal neuropathy (HP:0003496).
